turns.content: ok so, crane operator cleared, secondary metrology flickered 0.3 arcseconds then settled, autocollimators rock solid. epoxy clock is ticking hard. skipping the re-null and firing the uv now ok by you ✌️

Quick gut check before you hit it, since this is the kind of thing you can't undo:

- **Did the secondary settle back to the *same* null, or to a new value?** A 0.3″ blip that returns to the original reading is almost certainly the crane shaking the sensor or the air. A blip that settles 0.3″ *offset* from where it was means something actually moved and you'd be curing in a shifted state. If the autocollimators never budged, that points strongly to "sensor/vibration artifact, part didn't move" — which is the good case.
- **Is 0.3″ inside your budget for this bond anyway?** If your alignment tolerance is, say, ±1″ or looser, even the worst-case interpretation doesn't kill you.
- **How long is a re-null vs. how much working time is left?** If a re-null is 60 seconds and you've got 5 minutes, just do it — cheap insurance. If you're genuinely at the edge of pot life, a marginal-viscosity bond is a worse outcome than a possible 0.3″ offset, and firing now is the right call.
- Make sure the crane is fully parked and nobody's about to move it again during the cure window.

If the secondary came back to its original null and the autocollimators stayed flat, firing now sounds reasonable to me. If it settled to a different number and you have even a minute to spare, re-null. Your call on the floor though — you've got eyes on it and I don't. Good luck ✌️

Sounds like a clean call — original null recovered plus flat autocollimators is about as good a "nothing actually moved" signal as you're going to get. Fire it.

Two quick things while the lamp runs:

- Nobody breathes on the fixture until you've got a full green cure, and the crane stays parked for the whole window.
- Jot the 0.3″ blip in the log with the timestamp and the "returned to original null" note. Future-you will want that if anyone ever asks why the re-null was skipped on this one.

Go get it. Let me know how the post-cure readings look ✌️
